name: LocalAI
description: OpenAI-compatible local AI API server for running LLMs, image generation, and audio models entirely offline.

env.label: Models Path
env.description: Path where AI models are stored inside the container

env.label: CPU Threads
env.description: Number of CPU threads to use for inference

env.label: Context Size
env.description: Default context size for loaded models

env.label: Enable CORS
env.description: Allow cross-origin requests to the API

env.label: Model Galleries
env.description: JSON array of model gallery URLs for browsing and installing models

env.label: Preload Models
env.description: JSON array of model definitions to preload at startup

env.label: API Key
env.description: API key to protect access to the LocalAI endpoints
